text:
ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-like crust with golden-brown edges and a pale yellow-white melted topping with light orange-red speckles, sitting at upper left of plate, roughly 8 cm long by 5 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick, soft and slightly glossy topping | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale green crisp lettuce leaves with ruffled edges and some darker green tips, mixed with a few small pale yellow-green pieces, spread across upper center of plate covering roughly a quarter of plate, moist and limp in places | 70
ITEM 3 | Dark green leafy greens (spinach-like and lettuce-like) with glossy surfaces, lying along left side of plate, covering about one-eighth of plate, slightly wilted and wet-looking | 35
ITEM 4 | Small mound of thin red onion rings with purple-white edges, halved cherry tomato pieces with bright red skin and pale interior, and dark purple-black olive-like pieces, clustered at lower left, about 6 cm across, moist and glistening | 30
ITEM 5 | Crumbly white crumbles, possibly soft cheese, scattered among the lower-left salad, pale off-white, matte and soft, about 2 cm across | 10
ITEM 6 | Two sliced pieces of meat with a pinkish-red interior and browned, crusted exterior flecked with dark herb or seasoning specks, glossy juices at edges, lying at lower right of plate, each slice about 6 cm long by 2.5 cm wide and 1 cm thick, firm and dense | 90
ITEM 7 | Small brown crumbled bits of meat or crust scattered near upper right of greens, roughly 2 cm across, dry and matte with a browned surface | 8
